messages:
emma: Noticing several postmortems where action items never closed. I want a compact, required follow-up checklist and a short SLA + rotation for remediation owners.

raheem: Yes please. The main failure mode is unclear ownership after IC hands off. We should require a remediation owner (separate from IC) and an explicit verification method.

zoe: Quick prototype idea: small YAML blob in the postmortem that feeds the tracker. Something like:
```yaml
- id: AI-001
  summary: Fix retry logic for router
  owner: raheem
  owner_ack: null
  severity: P0
  due: 2024-11-05
  verification: integration test + load run
  recurrence_count: 1
  status: open
```
This would make parsing automated and allow incident-bot to nudge owners.

tara: Love the YAML approach. For SLAs I propose: owner assigned & ACK in 48h, mitigation plan in 7d, remediation PR or rollback plan in 14d for P0/P1, full closure in 30d for P0 unless exception approved by oncall lead.

emma: Also want a short comms cadence:
- day 0: postmortem draft link + initial action list
- day 2: owner ACK summary in thread
- weekly: short progress update pinned to thread if open after 7d
- on close: verification note + metrics snapshot attached
- 90d: auto recurrence check and trend note if recurrence_count > 0

raheem: For tooling: incident-bot should support commands: `/followup create <incident> <id> <7d,30d>` which will schedule DMs and channel pings. Also add a small UI in the playbooks repo (a table view).

incident-bot: I can do that. I will expose `/followup create` and `/followup list`. I'll post automated pings at ACK deadline and due_date -3d, due_date, and verification window.

zoe: Operational note: let's keep a weekly "remediation-oncall" slot (not the IC) for quick assignment if owner not claimed after 48h. It rotates weekly and lives in the oncall calendar. Who wants to be first pilot?

raheem: I can take the first two weeks. I'll help wire the bot.

emma: Great. Action items from this thread:
- zoe: add YAML template to playbooks + example parser (ETA 4d)
- raheem: instrument incident-bot commands + scheduler (ETA 1w)
- tara: update postmortem form to require remediation_owner and verification_steps (ETA EOW)
- emma: create remediation-oncall rota entry and short runbook for reassignment (ETA 3d)

tara: One more: add a recurrence_count field to the incident metadata and surface a monthly report of top recurring incidents so we can prioritize systemic fixes.

emma: Agreed. Also let's make the tracker CSV headers explicit so SRE/eng can query easily. Suggested headers: incident_id, severity, action_id, owner, owner_ack_ts, created_ts, due_ts, status, verification, linked_prs, recurrence_count, notes

raheem: I'll fork the playbook, add a sample incident with two AI items, and demo the bot flow in next week's oncall sync.

zoe: Thanks all. If you have concerns about deadlines being unrealistic, say now. Otherwise I'll open the PR to playbooks with the YAML template and schema.

emma: No objections. Please ping this thread when PRs are up. :sparkles:
